calls.video_title: A Once in a 100 Year Investment Opportunity Just Started (Felix Nikolas Prehn on Where He's Buying)
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked. Blue-chip gold miner: generates real cash at $4,000/oz gold with extraction costs far below the price, so any gold rebound is leveraged into pure profit.
calls.base_case: Cash-generative at current gold prices; rebound in gold flows straight to profit.
calls.bull_case: Gold runs to $4,500-5,000 and miners throw off much more cash.
calls.bear_case: Gold falls and the leverage works the other way.
